scoring_justification: Checker recomputes isotope shift from raw volume-pressure pairs in CSV via finite-difference compressibility and exponential+Gaussian peak fitting; compares to paper-reported gold (27 GPa) with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: isotope_shift gold value for BLYP at 1000 K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Supplementary section 'Comparison of exchange-correlation functionals' states ΔP_BLYP = 27 GPa.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly reported in the paper; used as reference target for agent's computed shift.

outputs.description: Raw compressibility data; the checker recomputes κ_T from volume and pressure and refits the peaks.
Agent-reported transition pressures and isotope shift; checker compares shift to hidden paper gold and verifies correct trend (H2 < D2).

output_contract.notes: The scored target is the isotope shift ΔP = P_D2 - P_H2 at 1000 K, determined from compressibility peaks. The CSV provides the raw data enabling independent refitting by the checker.

steps.description: CSV exists and contains required columns with parsable data.
Recompute isotope shift from raw CSV volume-pressure data and compare to hidden gold (27 GPa).
Agent's reported isotope shift in JSON matches the shift recomputed from their CSV within tolerance.
